# Westside-Old Window Repair

> Repair — not replacement — of original double-hung, casement and storm windows in Cincinnati's older West Side homes. Owner Mark Gay has 40+ years of hands-on experience. Phone: (513) 921-1244. Service-area business based in Cincinnati, Ohio (no walk-in showroom).

## Key facts
- Business name on Google: Westside - Old Window Repair
- Phone: (513) 921-1244
- Hours: Mon 9:00 AM–3:00 PM; Tue–Fri 9:00 AM–4:30 PM; Sat 9:00 AM–2:00 PM; Sun closed
- Service area: Cincinnati's West Side — Westwood, Cheviot, Price Hill, Delhi Township, Green Township, Bridgetown, Covedale, Mack, Monfort Heights, White Oak, Sayler Park, North Bend, Cleves, Addyston, Colerain Township, Harrison — and nearby communities
- Services: double-hung sash cord & weight repair (re-roping, freeing stuck sashes), glazing repair & repainting, casement window repair, storm panel repair
- Does NOT sell or install replacement windows; does not service vinyl/aluminum replacement units
- Google Maps listing: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=5809751457807609231
